- Wi-Fi: the speed test now matches speed.cloudflare.com exactly: the same 25 steps (latency, downloads from 100 kB to 250 MB, uploads, packet loss), the same calculations (90th percentile, median, jitter, loaded latency) and the same layout, with pause, a star rating of network quality, the server map, detailed measurements and CSV export
- SDR: new Meshtastic receiver (receive and decode only) with region, preset, frequency and channel selection (key AQ== for the public channel)
- SDR: new GPS receiver that computes your position with the HackRF alone and its stock telescopic antenna (satellites, signal in dB-Hz, PDOP, GPS time, crystal drift)
